title: Weakness Report
description: DISCOVER-stage artifact. Output of weakness-spotter. Enumerates methodological weaknesses found in the surveyed literature. Each weakness item carries a locus (where the weakness is) and an opportunity (the opening it creates), so the item is a direct classify_gap signal that maps to (methodological_gap, WEAK_LOCUS). An empty weaknesses array is allowed (the surveyed work may have no identifiable weaknesses). Every present item carries at least one non-blank evidence_ref (anti-slop): an item with no real evidence is schema-rejected.

weaknesses.description: Identified methodological weaknesses; each carries locus + opportunity so classify_gap can consume it directly.

locus.description: Where the weakness is — a paper or claim reference (the methodological weak point). Non-blank required.

opportunity.description: The opening the weakness creates for new research. Non-blank required.

evidence_ref.description: Evidence pointers (source_refs / paper_note ids) grounding this weakness (anti-slop). At least one required; each must be non-blank.

source_ref.description: Optional direct source reference for this weakness.
